tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: The MIC values (µM) of the engineered peptides against C. albicans cgmcc 2.2086 in the presence of physiological salts.
footnotes: The determination of control MIC values was conducted without physiological salts.

The concentrations of NaCl, KCl, NH4Cl, MgCl2, CaCl2, ZnCl2 and FeCl3 were determined to be 150 mM, 4.5 mM, 6 μM, 1 mM, 2 mM, 8 μM and 4 μM, respectively. These values were obtained by representative values from three separate experimental trials.
GMsalt is the geometric mean of MIC values of the engineered peptides in the presence of physiological salt ions.
Fold change multiplier was the GM ratio to the control.
